Automorphic_Form.title: Automorphic Form
Automorphic_Form.define: An automorphic form is a highly symmetric complex-valued function on an arithmetic quotient of a reductive group.

Dirichlet_Character.title: Dirichlet Character
Dirichlet_Character.define: A Dirichlet character is a periodic multiplicative arithmetic function modulo an integer.

Field.title: Field
Field.define: A field is an algebraic structure where addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division by nonzero elements are all possible.

Function.title: Function
Function.define: A function assigns each input exactly one output.

Galois_Representation.title: Galois Representation
Galois_Representation.define: A Galois representation is a homomorphism from a Galois group into a linear group over a coefficient field.

Global_Field.title: Global Field
Global_Field.define: A global field is either a number field or a function field of one variable over a finite field.

Integer_Ring.title: Integer Ring
Integer_Ring.define: The integer ring is the set of integers with usual addition and multiplication.

L_Function.title: L Function
L_Function.define: An $L$-function is a complex analytic object that encodes arithmetic data through Euler products, Dirichlet series, and functional equations.

Local_Field.title: Local Field
Local_Field.define: A local field is a field complete with respect to a nontrivial discrete valuation and having finite residue field.

Mobius_Function.title: Mobius Function
Mobius_Function.define: The Mobius function is an arithmetic function that records the square-free prime factor structure of an integer.

Modular_Form.title: Modular Form
Modular_Form.define: A modular form is a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane satisfying a specific transformation law and growth condition.

Natural_Number.title: Natural Number
Natural_Number.define: Natural numbers are the discrete numbers used for counting and indexing.

Number_Field.title: Number Field
Number_Field.define: A number field is a finite field extension of the rational numbers.

Prime.title: Prime
Prime.define: A prime number is a natural number greater than one whose only positive divisors are one and itself.

Rational_Number_Field.title: Rational Number Field
Rational_Number_Field.define: The rational number field consists of ratios of integers with nonzero denominator under ordinary arithmetic.

Riemann_Zeta_Function.title: Riemann Zeta Function
Riemann_Zeta_Function.define: The Riemann zeta function packages the arithmetic of positive integers into a complex analytic function.

Ring.title: Ring
Ring.define: A ring is an algebraic structure with addition, subtraction, and multiplication, where multiplication need not be commutative or invertible.

Set.title: Set
Set.define: A set is a collection of distinct objects considered as a single mathematical object.

p_Adic_Number.title: p Adic Number
p_Adic_Number.define: The $p$-adic numbers form the basic characteristic-zero local field attached to a prime $p$.

Complex_Valued_Function.title: Complex Valued Function
Complex_Valued_Function.define: A complex-valued function assigns a complex number to each point of its domain.
